10	import '../cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart';
11	
12	/// TIPO DE ENTRADA's own label for each [EntrySource]
13	/// (`prototype-extract.md` Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro) — shared by this
14	/// sheet's own chips and `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s active-filter chip row,
15	/// so the two surfaces never drift out of sync with each other (Code Map).
16	String entrySourceLabel(EntrySource source) => switch (source) {
17	  EntrySource.manual => 'Manual',
18	  EntrySource.audio => 'Áudio',
19	  EntrySource.photo => 'Foto',
20	  EntrySource.chat => 'Chat',
21	};
22	
23	/// [DateRangePreset]'s own UI copy — kept out of the domain enum itself,
24	/// same split [entrySourceLabel] already gives [EntrySource]; shared by
25	/// this sheet's own chips and `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s active-filter chip
26	/// row.
27	String dateRangePresetLabel(DateRangePreset preset) => switch (preset) {
28	  DateRangePreset.allTime => 'Todo o período',
29	  DateRangePreset.thisWeek => 'Esta semana',
30	  DateRangePreset.thisMonth => 'Este mês',
31	};
32	
33	/// The filter bottom sheet (spec-5-2) — two single-choice groups
34	/// ("INTERVALO DE DATA", "TIPO DE ENTRADA"; Design Notes: no "CATEGORIA"
35	/// group — the backend has no category filter, RF06) plus "Aplicar"/
36	/// "Limpar". Mirrors `InsertionModal.show()`'s own bottom-sheet
37	/// choreography (`isScrollControlled`, `useSafeArea`, `colorScrimHeavy`, a
38	/// Reduce-Motion-aware `durationSheetUp` entrance) — Code Map.
39	class EntriesFilterSheet extends StatefulWidget {
40	  const EntriesFilterSheet({
41	    required this.cubit,
42	    required this.searchCubit,
43	    super.key,
44	  });
45	
46	  /// Passed in directly rather than read via `context.read` (same
47	  /// rationale `InsertionModal`'s own cubit constructor params give): a
48	  /// `showModalBottomSheet` route's `builder` context is inserted above
49	  /// `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s own `MultiBlocProvider`, not below it, so
50	  /// nothing that `BlocProvider` exposes would be reachable from here
51	  /// anyway.
52	  final MeusRegistrosCubit cubit;
53	
54	  /// spec-5-3 — `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s own bridge to
55	  /// `EntriesSearchCubit` (Design Notes: the two cubits never import each
56	  /// other, RNF06); [_EntriesFilterSheetState._applyAndClose] calls
57	  /// [cubit]'s `applyFilters()` and this cubit's own `updateFilters()`
58	  /// side by side.
59	  final EntriesSearchCubit searchCubit;
60	
61	  /// Presents the sheet exactly as the class doc describes. [cubit]'s own
62	  /// `applyFilters()` is called directly by this sheet's "Aplicar" button
63	  /// (`_EntriesFilterSheetState._applyAndClose`) — this `static` method
64	  /// itself never touches the cubit.
65	  static Future<void> show(
66	    BuildContext context, {
67	    required MeusRegistrosCubit cubit,
68	    required EntriesSearchCubit searchCubit,
69	  }) async {
70	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
71	    final controller =
72	        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
73	          ..duration = reduceMotion
74	              ? Duration.zero
75	              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
76	          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
77	    try {
78	      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
79	        context: context,
80	        isScrollControlled: true,
81	        useSafeArea: true,
82	        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
83	        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
84	        elevation: 0,
85	        transitionAnimationController: controller,
86	        builder: (_) =>
87	            EntriesFilterSheet(cubit: cubit, searchCubit: searchCubit),
88	      );
89	    } finally {
90	      // Same "wait for the exit animation before disposing the
91	      // controller" rationale as `InsertionModal.show()`'s own `finally`
92	      // block (see its doc for the full explanation) — disposing the
93	      // moment `showModalBottomSheet`'s own `Future` resolves would cut
94	      // the still-running reverse animation's ticker off mid-flight.
95	      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
96	        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
97	        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
98	          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
99	            animationDone.complete();
100	          }
101	        }
102	
103	        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);
104	        await animationDone.future;
105	        controller.removeStatusListener(onStatusChange);
106	      }
107	      controller.dispose();
108	    }
109	  }
110	
111	  @override
112	  State<EntriesFilterSheet> createState() => _EntriesFilterSheetState();
113	}
114	
115	class _EntriesFilterSheetState extends State<EntriesFilterSheet> {
116	  late EntrySource? _pendingSource;
117	  late DateRangePreset _pendingDateRange;
118	
119	  @override
120	  void initState() {
121	    super.initState();
122	    // Pre-selects whichever filters are already active — `docs/input/` is
123	    // silent on this exact behavior (AGENTS.md policy: "decide and
124	    // proceed") — rather than always reopening blank, so reopening the
125	    // sheet to tweak just one filter doesn't silently discard the other.
126	    // Round-2 review fix: reads the cubit's own stored preset directly
127	    // rather than re-deriving it from `activeDateFrom` by equality match —
128	    // that re-derivation went stale (mis-pre-selecting "Todo o período")
129	    // the moment a day/week/month boundary rolled over while the filter
130	    // stayed active.
131	    _pendingSource = widget.cubit.activeSource;
132	    _pendingDateRange = widget.cubit.activeDateRangePreset;
133	  }
134	
135	  void _applyAndClose() {
136	    final (dateFrom, dateTo) = _pendingDateRange.rangeFrom(DateTime.now());
137	    widget.cubit.applyFilters(
138	      source: _pendingSource,
139	      dateFrom: dateFrom,
140	      dateTo: dateTo,
141	      dateRangePreset: _pendingDateRange,
142	    );
143	    // spec-5-3 — right alongside the existing `applyFilters()` call above:
144	    // a search that's currently active must carry this same filter
145	    // selection too (Boundaries), not just the plain/filtered timeline.
146	    widget.searchCubit.updateFilters(
147	      source: _pendingSource,
148	      dateFrom: dateFrom,
149	      dateTo: dateTo,
150	    );
151	    Navigator.of(context).pop();
152	  }
153	
154	  /// "Limpar" (Boundaries: "resets only the sheet's own pending
155	  /// selection") — never touches [widget.cubit]/closes the sheet; that's
156	  /// `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s separate "Limpar filtros" link's own job
157	  /// (`MeusRegistrosCubit.clearFilters()`).
158	  void _clearPending() {
159	    setState(() {
160	      _pendingSource = null;
161	      _pendingDateRange = DateRangePreset.allTime;
162	    });
163	  }
164	
165	  @override
166	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
167	    return Container(
168	      padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
169	      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
170	        color: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
171	        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
172	          top: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusLg),
173	        ),
174	        boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation2,
175	      ),
176	      child: SafeArea(
177	        top: false,
178	        // Epic-5 context's own UX note: "Filter chips and the search/
179	        // filter surfaces are a tight-fit area for Dynamic Type — verify
180	        // text does not truncate or clip at the largest accessibility
181	        // size" — a `SingleChildScrollView` guards against this sheet's
182	        // own content overflowing the screen at a large accessibility
183	        // text size, same safety net `InsertionModal`'s own tab content
184	        // already has (wrapped in its own `Flexible`/
185	        // `SingleChildScrollView` pair).
186	        child: SingleChildScrollView(
187	          child: Column(
188	            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
189	            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
190	            children: [
191	              Text(
192	                'INTERVALO DE DATA',
193	                style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
194	                  color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
195	                ),
196	              ),
197	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
198	              Wrap(
199	                spacing: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
200	                runSpacing: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
201	                children: [
202	                  for (final preset in DateRangePreset.values)
203	                    _FilterChip(
204	                      label: dateRangePresetLabel(preset),
205	                      selected: _pendingDateRange == preset,
206	                      onTap: () => setState(() => _pendingDateRange = preset),
207	                    ),
208	                ],
209	              ),
210	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingLg),
211	              Text(
212	                'TIPO DE ENTRADA',
213	                style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
214	                  color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
215	                ),
216	              ),
217	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
218	              Wrap(
219	                spacing: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
220	                runSpacing: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
221	                children: [
222	                  for (final source in EntrySource.values)
223	                    _FilterChip(
224	                      label: entrySourceLabel(source),
225	                      selected: _pendingSource == source,
226	                      // Single choice (Design Notes): unlike the date-range
227	                      // group above (whose 3 choices always include an
228	                      // explicit "none" — [DateRangePreset.allTime]),
229	                      // source has no dedicated "any source" chip — tapping
230	                      // the already-selected one toggles it back off
231	                      // instead of being a no-op, since that's otherwise
232	                      // the only way to clear just this one group without
233	                      // "Limpar" resetting the date group too.
234	                      onTap: () => setState(
235	                        () => _pendingSource = _pendingSource == source
236	                            ? null
237	                            : source,
238	                      ),
239	                    ),
240	                ],
241	              ),
242	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingLg),
243	              Row(
244	                children: [
245	                  Expanded(
246	                    child: AppButton(
247	                      label: 'Limpar',
248	                      variant: AppButtonVariant.textGhost,
249	                      onPressed: _clearPending,
250	                    ),
251	                  ),
252	                  const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
253	                  Expanded(
254	                    child: AppButton(
255	                      label: 'Aplicar',
256	                      onPressed: _applyAndClose,
257	                    ),
258	                  ),
259	                ],
260	              ),
261	            ],
262	          ),
263	        ),
264	      ),
265	    );
266	  }
267	}
268	
269	/// One selectable group option — reused by both groups ("INTERVALO DE
270	/// DATA"/"TIPO DE ENTRADA"); selected state is `colorSecondary` fill +
271	/// `colorCategoryChipText` text, same token pair the active-filter chip
272	/// row (`MeusRegistrosScreen`) reuses for its own chips (Boundaries: exact
273	/// token reuse, no new token). Unselected state is a plain `colorBorder`
274	/// outline — not itself named by Boundaries, since only the *selected*
275	/// look is actually specified there.
276	class _FilterChip extends StatelessWidget {
277	  const _FilterChip({
278	    required this.label,
279	    required this.selected,
280	    required this.onTap,
281	  });
282	
283	  final String label;
284	  final bool selected;
285	  final VoidCallback onTap;
286	
287	  @override
288	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
289	    return Semantics(
290	      button: true,
291	      selected: selected,
292	      label: label,
293	      excludeSemantics: true,
294	      child: InkWell(
295	        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
296	          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
297	        ),
298	        onTap: onTap,
299	        child: Container(
300	          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
301	            horizontal: DesignTokens.spacingMd,
302	            vertical: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
303	          ),
304	          decoration: BoxDecoration(
305	            color: selected
306	                ? DesignTokens.colorSecondary
307	                : DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
308	            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
309	              Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
310	            ),
311	            border: selected
312	                ? null
313	                : Border.all(
314	                    color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
315	                    width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault,
316	                  ),
317	          ),
318	          child: Text(
319	            label,
320	            style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd.copyWith(
321	              color: selected
322	                  ? DesignTokens.colorCategoryChipText
323	                  : DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
324	            ),
325	          ),
326	        ),
327	      ),
328	    );
329	  }
330	}

43	/// `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s one record card — mirrors
44	/// `placeholder_screens.dart`'s `_KanbanCard` structure (colored left
45	/// spine over a `Stack`, Code Map) but for an [Entry]: spine colored by
46	/// [Entry.source], a source icon, the local time, a content excerpt, and
47	/// (spec-4-2) its own [SyncBadge]. spec-4-4: [onTap] is this card's one

Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

All 840 tests pass, and `flutter analyze` reports zero issues. Here's a summary of what changed on the Meus Registros screen to match the frozen prototype:

**Search/filter row** (`entries_search_bar.dart`)
- Split into two separate bordered pills (search field + round filter button), each with `colorBorder`/`radiusFull`, matching the prototype's two sibling elements instead of one shadowed box.
- Added the leading magnifying-glass icon.

**Filter sheet** (`entries_filter_sheet.dart`)
- Added the "Filtrar registros" title.
- Reordered groups: "TIPO DE ENTRADA" first, then "PERÍODO" (renamed from "INTERVALO DE DATA").
- Removed the "Limpar" button — "Aplicar" is now the only, full-width button.
- Selected chips now fill `colorPrimary`/`colorOnPrimary` (dark green) instead of the olive `colorSecondary` pair.

**Active-filters row** (`meus_registros_screen.dart`)
- Chips are now small, `radiusSm`-rounded, `colorSecondaryTint` (olive at 18%) — not large solid pills.
- "Limpar filtros" is now a small gray monospace link on the same row as the chips, not a standalone green button on its own line.
- Date-group labels ("Hoje"/"Ontem") now use small gray monospace text instead of large bold text.

**Record card** (`entry_record_card.dart`, `sync_badge.dart`)
- The sync indicator moved to the right of the first row (next to the time) instead of below the content.
- Added a `compact` variant to `SyncBadge` so the card renders the label lowercase in gray (dot stays colored by state) — the shared badge keeps its original colored/capitalized look where it's used elsewhere (`EntryDetailScreen`, which has no prototype reference).

New tokens were added to `design_tokens.dart` (`colorSecondaryTint`, `entriesSearchBarIconSize`, `activeFilterChip*`) per RNF08. Tests covering the sheet's old "Limpar" button and label text were updated/removed to match; no other behavior (filter logic, search bridging, retry wiring) changed.
